messages:
maya.marketing: Quick kickoff — thinking a focused 3-week push: 3 short tutorials (video + repo), 1 tiny reference app (refkit-lite), and a webinar. Main goals: community signal, demoable reference implementation, and a benchmark narrative we can cite in the launch post. Draft plan: https://docs.redwood.ai/launch/refkit-lite (WIP)

sam.devrel: Love this. Can we make the tutorials super snackable (10–12 min) and one deep-dive notebook? :+1:

olivia.content: I can take the launch post + twitter thread. Need the benchmark numbers and one customer quote or internal use case to make it tangible.

raj.eng: I can run a lightweight benchmark matrix tomorrow — g5/g6, quantized vs fp16, batch sizes [1,4,8]. Should take ~3 hrs. benchbot: scheduled job queued for 04:00 UTC.

ben.growth: For inbound routing: recommend gated webinar signup + two flows: enterprise-looking leads -> SDR queue, everyone else -> nurture drip + auto-invite to community. Jenna, can your team pick up the SDR routing?

jenna.sales: Yep. We need clear qualification rules. Suggest: company_size >= 100 OR monthly_tokens >= 200k => SDR. Also flag any GitHub org or OSS contributors as high intent.

kai.engineer: I'll own the refapp repo and the CI. Can we keep the refapp to a single docker service + minimal infra (k8s manifest + local dev compose)? Also want to include perf profiling notes.

maya.marketing: Nice. Olivia — for messaging variants, propose A) "Ship LLM features faster with refkit-lite + Redwood" B) "Benchmark-backed reference for predictable inference costs". We should A/B test header copy on the landing page.

olivia.content: Draft tweet threads: 1) launch TL;DR + benchmark highlight 2) dev thread with quickstart and PR examples. Will drop drafts by EOD.

sam.devrel: For tutorials: 1) Quickstart (15m) 2) Optimize latency/cost (12m) 3) Advanced: rollouts & canary (20m). Anyone wants to record? I can host video 1 & 3.

raj.eng: Bench results ETA 24h. Will attach CSV + short notes. Quick heads-up: quantized 4-bit gives ~2.3x token/sec increase on g6 in our early pass.

ben.growth: Inbound routing rules (first draft):
```
if company_size >= 100 or monthly_tokens >= 200000:
  route = "sales-sdr"
elif github_contrib == true or opensource_org == true:
  route = "devrel-high-intent"
else:
  route = "marketing-nurture"
```
We can tweak thresholds after week 1.

jenna.sales: That looks good. Also add a "paying-customer" flag to always prioritize (if present route to account-exec).

maya.marketing: Operational checklist (quick):
- raj: bench CSV + summary (24h)
- kai: refapp repo + CI (72h)
- sam: tutorial scripts + recordings (5 days)
- olivia: launch post + tweet threads (EOD + final before publish)
- ben: landing + forms + routing (2 days)
- jenna: SDR mapping + playbook (2 days)

sam.devrel: Also suggest a tiny eval harness for the refapp so users can reproduce perf numbers: a script that runs N iterations and uploads a small result JSON.

kai.engineer: I'll add perf harness to repo. Will include runbook and a sample result file.

olivia.content: For the benchmark narrative — keep it honest: include model, seq len, batching, and region. One-line kicker: "Refkit-lite: predictable latency, lower unit cost"

maya.marketing: Cool. Can we lock publish date? target = two weeks from today, webinar 3 days after. If any blockers surface, we push.

raj.eng: Bench complete — uploading in 30m. Early numbers look promising.

benchbot: build/test for refkit-lite passed (ci/refkit-lite #72) :white_check_mark:

ben.growth: Small ask — add an email drip variant specifically for open-source maintainers and trial users. We'll measure click-to-signup.

jenna.sales: We'll prepare a short SDR playbook with 3 opening lines and qualification checklist.

maya.marketing: Great progress — thanks all. Olivia/Sam/Ben, sync in 30 to finalize launch timeline and assign final copy reviews. :calendar:
